zones.label: Alcohol
zones.summary: Alcohol can impair judgment, coordination, memory, and breathing at high exposure.
facts: It interacts with many medicines and drugs.

zones.label: Nicotine
zones.summary: Nicotine can increase heart rate, affect attention and mood, and produce dependence.

zones.label: Cannabis
zones.summary: Cannabis can affect memory, attention, coordination, judgment, and anxiety.
facts: Combining it with other impairing substances increases risk.

zones.label: Stimulants
zones.summary: Stimulants can increase alertness, heart rate, temperature, anxiety, and sleep disruption.
facts: Medical use and misuse are different.
Unknown products may contain unexpected substances.

zones.label: Opioids
zones.summary: Opioids can relieve pain but can also slow breathing and cause dependence or overdose.
facts: Risk rises with sedatives or reduced tolerance.
Naloxone can temporarily reverse opioid overdose while emergency help is called.

zones.label: Medications
zones.summary: Medicines have intended effects, side effects, and interaction risks.
facts: Use only as directed for the correct person.
Ask a pharmacist before combining substances.
